{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Calculate response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rate_by_site = response_rate_by_site.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

# Print results
print(f'Response rate by site:\n{response_rate_by_site}')
print(f'\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate})')"}
